races.paceDynamic: Borora Aura emerges as the likely sole pace-setter with her prominent style, facing minimal early pressure from the hold-up heavy field. Aurevoir Tristesse may show early but lacks the pace credentials to sustain pressure on Borora Aura through the first mile. The sustained tempo will create a genuine staying test over this extended trip on yielding ground. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the pace-setter will be vulnerable to being reeled in during the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Borora Aura sets uncontested fractions and tires in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks on ground that rewards stamina. Divelment and Personified benefit most from this tactical scenario with their proven hold-up styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Borora Aura maintains her kick despite the testing conditions
scenarios.body: Her prominent style proves sustainable over the trip as hold-up horses struggle to make up significant ground on the yielding surface. The lack of early pace harassment allows her to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Complications
scenarios.trigger: If early pace becomes contested or Borora Aura fails to show her usual speed
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no clear pace-setter, creating stop-start fractions that disrupt normal running patterns. This chaos can benefit horses who adapt quickly to changing race dynamics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Eliminates
scenarios.trigger: If the yielding ground and extended trip proves too demanding for most
scenarios.body: The combination of testing conditions and distance creates an extreme staying examination that only the most genuine stayers can handle. Very few horses have the stamina reserves to compete effectively.

races.paceDynamic: Glamazon will set the pace from the front with Avec Grand Plaisir likely to track in second, creating a moderate gallop over this stamina-testing trip on yielding ground. The prominent pair won't be pressured early, allowing them to dictate fractions that could prove too strong for the hold-up brigade. With six runners committed to racing from the back (Maxminelli, Cascade Canyon, Priorstown, Lord Aus, Premier Princess, Pass The Buck), they'll need the leaders to collapse to be effective. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and early pace-setters who can sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Glamazon Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Glamazon gets an easy lead and isn't pressured by Avec Grand Plaisir early
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain a steady rhythm that proves impossible to peg back, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do on ground that emphasises stamina over turn of foot. Glamazon's consistency and prominent style perfectly suits controlling from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Avec Grand Plaisir or another prominent runner pressures Glamazon from the start
scenarios.body: The early tempo becomes unsustainably fast, setting up the race for a closer with tactical speed. This brings the better-rated hold-up horses like Cascade Canyon and Maxminelli into serious contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where class and raw ability matter more than position. The highest-rated closers get their chance to showcase superior talent in a bunch finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace scenario creates chaos with leaders stopping and favourites disappointing
scenarios.body: An unfancied hold-up horse with fresh legs takes advantage of a perfectly-run race. Priorstown or Premier Princess could benefit from a truly-run race where stamina trumps class.

races.paceDynamic: A Pretty Penny is the sole confirmed front-runner and will face no early pressure, allowing her to dictate terms from the front at a comfortable gallop. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can track the leader closely, while the abundance of hold-up horses creates traffic problems in a crowded finish.

races.paceDynamic: Eben Zaabeel will lead from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters, creating a controlled gallop over this staying trip. Steps In The Sand and Mr Rango may press forward from prominent positions but neither is aggressive enough to pressure the leader significantly. The lack of early pace will create a tactical affair where the field bunches approaching the straight, setting up a sprint finish over the final 3 furlongs. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Eben Zaabeel sets a steady tempo and the field stays compact through the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 3-furlong pole as the hold-up horses unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. Proven finishers with tactical speed dominate as the modest early gallop plays into their hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Eben Zaabeel steals several lengths turning for home while the field hesitates
scenarios.body: The leader's class tells under Declan McDonogh as he kicks clear before the closers can organize their challenge. Only the sharpest finishers get close as the tempo lifts too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Steps In The Sand and Mr Rango both press Eben Zaabeel through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The increased gallop sets up perfectly for horses with early speed who can sustain their effort. The genuine pace exposes the hold-up horses who find the finish coming too quickly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Swoop Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and the field crawls through halfway splits
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing kick where only horses with explosive late gears can win. Class horses with proven ability to quicken from impossible positions thrive.
